unit.why: This is a teaching on the radiance of the faces of tsaddikim (item ב under the heading 'מענין זיו וזוהר הפנים'), with a Zohar citation; the author's one-line testimony that he once saw R. Zvi of Zhidachov's face shining like the sun illustrates the teaching but has no plot of its own.
